A reproducible data-liberation pipeline producing a tidy, well-documented
public dataset.

## What this is

{{ description }} The deliverable is a long-form tidy dataset with one
row per observation, joined to per-extract provenance, audited every
time it's regenerated, and published in three forms:

- **Browse and query interactively** at the [Datasette instance](https://{{ project_slug }}.vercel.app/).
- **Bulk-download** the latest CSV / Parquet from the
  [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/{{ owner }}/{{ project_slug }}/releases) page.
- **Reproduce from scratch** by cloning the repository and running
  `uv run python -m scripts.pipeline run` — full instructions in the
  [README](https://github.com/{{ owner }}/{{ project_slug }}#reproducibility).
